verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only Statsig's access-management basics: SSO login, SCIM provisioning and auto-adding users by email domain. The SCIM passages describe what SCIM does in general, not Statsig roles or permissions that limit who can change which flags. Nothing documents per-flag or per-resource permissions, change restrictions, or scoped API tokens, so this is adjacent identity management rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
